`class CircleNode`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.shape` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [CircleNode.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/shape/CircleNode.java)

Draws a filled disc in its bounds, with a color that fades on hover.

![A blue disc on a dark card](/captures/catalog-nodes-circlenode.webp)

## Description

The disc is centered in the bounds, with a diameter of the smaller of the width and the height.
